input.quote: 12.4 Customer shall not solicit, hire, or employ any Vendor employee during the term or for twenty-four months afterward, regardless of how the employee applies.
input.rationale: Section 12.4 binds only the Customer and is a true no-hire ("hire, or employ ... regardless of how the employee applies"), running 24 months and covering every Vendor employee rather than only personnel involved in the Services, with no general-advertising or unsolicited-approach carve-out. That is walk-away territory under the rule and fails the fallback on every material term (mutuality, scope, duration, carve-outs, no no-hire). It also conflicts with Section 12.3, which records that Customer has made no no-hire commitment and may hire anyone responding to general recruitment. We propose the minimal edit to reach the fallback: a mutual 12-month non-solicit limited to personnel directly involved in the Services with general-advertising and unsolicited-approach carve-outs and no no-hire.

proposal.summary: Narrow one-way 24-month no-hire to a mutual 12-month non-solicit limited to personnel involved in the Services, with general-advertising and unsolicited-approach carve-outs.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We cannot accept a no-hire covering every Vendor employee for 24 months with no general-advertising carve-out, particularly as Section 12.3 confirms we have made no no-hire commitment. We have narrowed this to our fallback: a mutual 12-month non-solicit limited to personnel directly involved in the Services, with the customary carve-outs.

ops.oldText: Customer shall not solicit, hire, or employ any Vendor employee during the term or for twenty-four months afterward, regardless of how the employee applies.
ops.newText: During the term and for twelve months after an individual's involvement ends, neither Party shall knowingly solicit for employment any personnel of the other Party who were directly involved in performing or receiving the Services. This Section does not restrict general advertisements, recruitment campaigns, or use of recruiters not targeted at the other Party's personnel, or the hiring of any person who responds to them or who approaches a Party on their own initiative, and neither Party is subject to any no-hire obligation.
